checks.explanation: Nicolas Maduro was captured and arrested by the United States on January 3, 2026 on narco-terrorism and other charges, roughly 2.5 months after this October 2025 interview, ending his regime as Machado predicted. Delcy Rodriguez, Maduro's vice president, took over as acting president amid an ongoing post-Maduro political transition.
